sizeGuide.title: How to choose a size
sizeGuide.intro: Measure over underwear with a tape measure: snug, but not tight.
sizeGuide.chestHow: Around the fullest part, keeping the tape level under the arms.
sizeGuide.waistHow: Around the narrowest part, usually just above the navel.
sizeGuide.hipsHow: Around the fullest part of the seat, keeping the tape level.
sizeGuide.inseamHow: From the crotch to the ankle along the inside of the leg.
sizeGuide.shoesIntro: Measure in the evening — feet are slightly larger by the end of the day — wearing the socks you'll wear with the shoes. Stand on a sheet of paper and trace your foot.
sizeGuide.footLengthHow: From the heel to the tip of the longest toe. Measure both feet and go with the larger one.
sizeGuide.footWidthHow: Across the widest part, at the base of the toes.
sizeGuide.headwearIntro: Measure without a hat, using a tape measure: snug, but not pressing.
sizeGuide.head: Head circumference
sizeGuide.headHow: One finger above the eyebrows, over the ears and around the fullest part of the back of the head.
sizeGuide.doubt: Not sure? Ask the seller — they know how this model fits.
